messages:
Noah T: heads up — installer via snap on ubuntu 22.04 left me with a broken config. redwoodctl can't write to ~/.redwood/config.yaml after first run.
Noah T: exact error when I try `redwoodctl login`: 
```
failed to save profile: open /home/noah/.redwood/config.yaml: permission denied
```
Jorge: snap confinement — it likely wrote configs into the snap's writable area and subsequent CLI (installed via apt) can't touch them. Which package did you use?
Noah T: used `snap install redwoodctl --channel=stable` for a quick test VM.
Priya M: yeah snaps are finicky with home dirs. Workarounds: 1) run with `REDWOODCTL_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.config/redwood redwoodctl login` to force a path the snap/cli can use; 2) install the deb or use `snap connect redwoodctl:home` if available.
Emma L: also for login the snap's browser integration failed so device auth fell through quickly. I needed to set `REDWOODCTL_BROWSER=none` to get the copy/paste code flow.
Noah T: even with copy/paste I hit flaky auth because the CLI gives up after 2 attempts on flaky network. Our SDK retries longer and succeeds. Any short-term knobs?
Priya M: you can increase retries with env `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_RETRIES=6` and `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_BACKOFF_MS=500` — that'll make the CLI behave more like SDK backoff. Not ideal but works for demo VMs.
Jorge: long-term fix: detect snap/apparmor confinement in installer and either adapt the default config dir or show a clear post-install note: "snap detected — run with REDWOODCTL_CONFIG_DIR or install the .deb for full filesystem access". Also make device auth fallback explicit when browser is unavailable.
DevEx Bot: created DEVEX-2101 "installer: detect snap confinement and set user-friendly config dir + auth fallback hints" (link: github.com/redwood-inference/installer/pull/619)
Emma L: small tip for local testing: `redwoodctl local-serve --profile demo --trust-ca /tmp/corp-ca.pem` avoids installing CA system-wide. Add that to the snap troubleshooting doc.
Noah T: confirmed: reinstalling with deb fixed the permission issues, and the env knobs fixed auth retry. I'll update the quickstart notes for Ubuntu snaps. Thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
